Okie Motor demo: sample data only. It starts on the lock page: swipe up, scroll or press a key. Add ?zen=0 to skip it, ?lang=de for German, ?squircle=standard for FSC's Balanced shape, ?splash=handwritten for the hello. Thermostat: ?f=1&open=climate.living_room opens the Nest of the house (Fahrenheit) at once.
